notes.title: The Journey VR - Patch 2.0
notes.content:
Hello, community!

Thank you for being an active part of our journey. We enjoyed your feedback and made several changes to the game.

We modified the way the user navigates within the spaceship, making it really easy for anyone. Also, several bugs have been fixed and the tests between the levels have been removed. Thus, the game will primarily focus on being an adventure game (with a big educational part in it).

Thank you,
MD Lab Games Team

notes.title: Patched
notes.content:
Patch 0.2 The Journey: 

The Journey VR works on every platform right now! Thank you for buying our game!


~ subtitles are now off 
~ the height of the character is now fixed 
~ the motion is fixed (only one controller is used for moving in the menu and in the lab)
